devdoc.details: Central management contract for the real estate security token system

calculateAnnualDividend().details: Calculates expected annual dividend based on current token supply and rate

params._totalAmount: Total amount of stablecoins for dividend distribution

fundRedemptionReserve(uint256).details: Funds the redemption reserve for token buybacks

params._amount: Amount of stablecoins to add to redemption reserve

mintTokens(address,uint256).details: Mints new tokens to an investor and registers their investment

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setupAgents().details: Sets system contracts as agents on the token

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._newRate: New dividend rate in basis points

params._newPenalty: New penalty rate in basis points

updatePlatformFee(uint256).details: Updates the secondary market platform fee
